note:
Yu Mincho / Yu Gothic: Office-private on macOS (Word lays out with its own
yumin.ttf / YuGoth*.ttc; advances read from those faces 2026-09-30, weighted
over a trilingual EN/JP/ID body). Apple's downloadable YuMincho/YuGothic cuts
share the design, so they lead: Yu Gothic Regular/Bold equal the Apple
Medium/Bold advances outright, Yu Mincho Demibold equals the Apple Demibold,
and Yu Mincho Regular differs per class (space 0.260 em vs 0.333). Where the
Apple cuts are absent the Liberation faces stand in with class scales.
Line geometry pinned to the Word faces' hhea (0.88 / 0.222) in every tier.
